facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: With the discovery of two additional mounds, the total area of the Rakhigarhi site will be 350 hectares... Mohenjo-daro, which was earlier thought to be the biggest Harappan-era site, is only about 300 hectares in size... what we are yet to figure out though, is whether this entire area was occupied simultaneously, or gradually brought under occupation.
facts.text: While excavators led by Vasant Shinde argue that newly identified outlying mounds expand Rakhigarhi to 350 hectares, making it larger than Mohenjo-daro, other archaeologists question whether all mounds formed a single continuous settlement or separate contemporary villages.

facts.label: legend
facts.quote: Villagers in Rakhi Shahpur and Rakhi Khas have long shared folklore of ancient buried kingdoms and mythological eras lying undisturbed beneath their agricultural mounds.
facts.text: Local oral lore around the villages of Rakhi Khas and Rakhi Shahpur long maintained that the towering unexcavated earth mounds hid enchanted kingdoms and treasures from the mythological Mahabharata era.
